applicabilityBasis.summary: sUSDx is an ERC-4626/ERC-7540 USDx savings receipt with a variable exchange rate as realized trading rewards vest. Redemption returns proportional USDx through an async queue rather than a fixed monetary-value payment. This is Pharos's editorial assessment of the exact savings-share structure, not a token-specific regulator determination or a finding that the parent USDx is outside GENIUS.

references.label: Axis savings-vault share and redemption accounting

genius.notes: sUSDx is the exact V2 ERC-4626/ERC-7540 appreciating USDx vault share: vested rewards increase USDx per share and async redemption returns proportional USDx, not a fixed monetary-value amount. This supports the separate non-payment-token assessment, independently of the unresolved parent USDx category. Existing issuerEntity Coordinate Origin Limited is preserved as the general issuance/redemption entity named in Axis terms, distinct from Singapore platform operator Coordinate Labs Pte. Ltd. The terms do not separately identify a legal issuer for the sUSDx contract share; no savings-share authorization is claimed. U.S.-person restrictions are access policy, not statutory exclusion. Its proposed MiCA out-of-scope row is limited to the EMT/ART stablecoin tracker because this exact share is not designed to preserve a fixed reference value; no financial-instrument exemption or exclusion from all MiCA/CASP obligations is asserted. OCC rules remain proposals.
